M1_CUT_01: ANYA: Good work getting here so fast. This mission has top priority. Target: Josef Priboi. You are to locate him and bring him out for debriefing. Josef is our only link with the heist of the warhead.
M1_CUT_02: JONES: Yeah, yeah. I need to know one thing, where he is.
M1_CUT_03: ANYA: Josef is held at a military airfield. The whole area has excellent air defences. We have to place you some distance from the target until those defense are disabled.
M1_CUT_05: ANYA: You'll cover the ground using locally resourced transportation assets.
M1_CUT_06: JONES: You mean I have to steal something?
M1_CUT_07: ANYA: Exactly. You will travel to the next goods yard - there you will resource transportation. The whole operation is simple - there are three stages:
M1_CUT_08: ANYA: One - acquire transportation assets. Two - disable air defences. Three - Find Josef Priboi and safely extract him for debriefing. Even...
M1_CUT_09: JONES: ...even a grunt like me can follow it - I see
M1_CUT_10: ANYA: That's the best we have.
M1_CUT_11: JONES: Anya, just how did you track Josef down?
M1_CUT_12: ANYA: We traced Josef's call to his apartment, right? Local agents raided it they found photos of Josef and his mobile number.
M1_CUT_13: ANYA: So, we called it and triangulated the co-ordinates. The mobile's located at a military airfield - that's where Josef is - that's our primary target.
M1_CUT_15: ANYA: You must make your way through the goods yard to the truck. Avoid the cameras at all cost - if you alert the security, you'll have the entire base zeroing in on your position.
M1_CUT_16: ANYA: Get to the truck. This is your objective on this mission. Reach it and steal it. I want this mission to be brief and above all quiet. Get to work Jones!
M1_MSG_1: ANYA: Steal the truck by the main entrance.
M1_MSG_2: ANYA: Watch out for the security cameras.
M1_MSG_3: ANYA: Avoid raising the alarm, Jones.
M1_MSG_4: ANYA: The truck is in the garage on the far side of the base.
M1_MSG_5: ANYA: The alarm has been raised. Watch out for security teams.
M1_MSG_6: ANYA: These gates are locked. You need to find another way in.
M1_MSG_7: ANYA: It looks like you can climb the fence into the next section.
M2_CUT_01: ANYA: The next objective is to disable the local air defences.
M2_CUT_02: JONES: Why not use the truck to evacuate Josef from the airfield?
M2_CUT_03: ANYA: Too slow, way too slow. It's too much of a risk. Josef's our only link with the heist.
M2_CUT_04: ANYA: He knew not only how the warhead had been taken, he knew the where, the how - heck he even quoted the warhead's damn serial number. We must have him in one piece and alive.
M2_CUT_06: ANYA: Here's what you have to do. Immediately infiltrate the SAM battery. You will find explosives here, set them on each of the SAM sites.
M2_CUT_07: ANYA: Escape to the final rendezvous point, and then detonate the explosive devices.
M2_CUT_08: ANYA: Once you are at the rendezvous point, we can then pick you up by chopper and fly directly to the military airbase.
M2_MSG_1: ANYA: You have the C4 now place 1 charge on the back of each SAM launcher.
M2_MSG_2: ANYA: Get to the helipad for extraction.
M3_CUT_01: JONES: That's another successful operation under my belt. Okay Anya, tell me where Josef is and I'll bring him out. Is there any news on the backup?
M3_CUT_02: ANYA: Surely you don't need anyone else's help. Your backup has just touched down in the capitol. They're currently enroute to you as we speak. They should be with you in about three hours.
M3_CUT_03: JONES: Just in time to clear up!
M3_CUT_04: ANYA: We've opened up the air corridor for Josef's extraction. The task now is to find Josef Priboi and bring him out for debriefing.
M3_CUT_06: ANYA: 1) Infiltrate the installation without overly raising suspicion;
M3_CUT_07: ANYA: 2) Locate and free Josef Priboi - Our agents have been on surveillance for the last 20 hours, they took this footage. I believe Josef to be held in this building - he should be held in the basement;
M3_CUT_08: ANYA: 3) Once you have Josef in custody, escort him back to FRV for chopper dust off.
M3_OUT_01: JONES: Easy tiger, wow! This is great, miles more than the simulator.
M3_OUT_02: ANYA: You crashed the simulator, six times!
M3_OUT_03: JONES: Got it right in the end though.
M3_OUT_04: ANYA: Uh, right. I've found a small airstrip for you to land at, your backup team will meet you there.
M3_OUT_05: ANYA: I'm realigning the satellites now. I'll be in contact in twenty minutes, here are your new flight co-ordinates - keep that plane low.
M3_MSG_1: ANYA: The airbase is located at the bottom of the hill behind the radar dome.
M3_MSG_2: ANYA: Josef should be located in the security building in the prison compound.
M3_MSG_3: ANYA: Jones, is Josef in the basement?
M3_MSG_4: ANYA: Josef's not here. He's been moved! The control tower will hold any flight records. Get there and search for those records, Jones.
M3_MSG_5: ANYA: New location of Josef found, now evacuate. Those jets should be the quickest way out. Time to steal one, Jones
M3_MSG_6: ANYA: Incoming enemy choppers! We need to evacuate the LZ, you're on your own for the moment.
M3_MSG_7: ANYA: Jones - AWACs has reported a lot of chopper activity to the south - it's within 10k of your current position.The chopper extraction is too risky. Anya to chopper, Anya to chopper, dust off
M3_MSG_9: ANYA: There's a jet, fuelled and ready to go - just don't do anything fancy in it, you don't have the training
M3_MSG_10: JONES: Anya - The cells are empty! Repeat, the cells are empty! Josef is not there!
M3_MSG_11: ANYA: Damn! He can't have come out by road; our agents would have spotted him.
M3_MSG_12: ANYA: They must have moved him by air, before we got into position.
M3_MSG_13: JONES: The control tower would hold the flight logs of all aircraft.
M3_MSG_14: ANYA: Excellent! Jones, listen up. Mission update, new objectives.
M3_MSG_15: ANYA: 1) Proceed to the Control tower
M3_MSG_16: ANYA: 2) Find the flight logs for today - there must be a record of Josef's destination - you have to find him before the warhead's trail grows cold. Find out where they took Josef
M3_MSG_17: ANYA: 3) Finally extract yourself using the plane. It looks like that support is going to come in useful.
M3_MSG_18: JONES: Anya - I've found where Josef was taken. Sending the co-ordinates now. This is odd - the log states there were two Pribois on board.
M3_MSG_19: ANYA: Just get out of there Jones. I'll check that out.
M4_CUT_01: ANYA: Jones, you identified this prison as Josef's destination. A man answering Josef's description arrived here yesterday.
M4_CUT_02: JONES: The back-up is here now. Who's leading them? What's their role?
M4_CUT_03: ANYA: Captain Harrison is in command - ex Green Beret. He is to lead the assault; his men are to go in and bring Josef out.
M4_CUT_04: ANYA: They lack as expert sniper. You are to provide cover as they go in.
M4_CUT_05: JONES: All right! I get to play god then?
M4_CUT_06: ANYA: I guess that's going to be your call sign. Harrison's sign will be Moses.
M4_CUT_08: ANYA: Jones, your objectives are as follows;
M4_CUT_09: ANYA: 1) Secure the ruins on the hill line above the prison. This will provide an excellent field of fire.
M4_CUT_10: ANYA: 2) Provide cover for Harrison's men as they assault.
M4_CUT_11: ANYA: 3) Once our guys have Josef, you will provide covering fire for the extraction.
M4_CUT_12: ANYA: 4) When Josef is safely away, Harrison will give you the signal to move to the FRV for extraction.
M4_MSG_1: ANYA: Secure the village then climb the water tower and provide sniper cover for the friendly troops.
M4_MSG_2: ANYA: Get in position and cover the friendly troops.
M4_MSG_4: ANYA: A gunship is approaching your position. Watch out!
M4_MSG_5: ANYA: Josef's dead, Jones! We've failed. Harrison, get your men moving, leave the body, mission abort! Repeat, mission abort!
M4_MSG_6: FRIENDLY SOLDIER: Alpha team, man down!
M4_MSG_7: CAPTAIN HARRISON: Alpha team, we're taking too many casulties, abort the mission! Repeat abort mission!
M4_MSG_8: CAPTAIN HARRISON: Josef located, we're bringing him out.
M4_MSG_9: ANYA: Helicopter will move in once you're in position on the water tower
M4_MSG_10: ANYA: The team is on the ground. They're moving into position
M4_MSG_11: ANYA: Jones - you remember the second Priboi from the flight log? I've tracked him down. Get this. Name Priboi, Jach. Age 45. 'Businessman'.
M4_MSG_12: ANYA: Uncle to one Josef Priboi. The family control a string of import export companies - a known front for black market smuggling and counterfeiting.
M4_MSG_13: ANYA: Recently suspected of worldwide arms trafficking. Also financially linked to local prominent politicians, military commanders and police in this part of the country.
M4_MSG_14: ANYA: His moniker is Jach the Hammer - well known for using a claw hammer during punishment beatings.
M4_MSG_15: JONES: Aiii! So he got his hands on Josef -his nephew - why? Blackmail by Josef?
M4_MSG_16: ANYA: Maybe, perhaps a double cross. The negotiations with Josef never progressed that far.
M4_MSG_17: ANYA: Jones - enemy soldiers, they're sneaking up on you! Watch out!
M4_MSG_18: JONES: Thanks for the warning, I owe you one.
M4_MSG_21: FRIENDLY SOLDIER: I'm holding the stairs.
M4_MSG_22: FRIENDLY SOLDIER: Basement Clear! Target found, repeat, target found
M5_CUT_01: JONES: How did Priboi's debrief go, Anya?
M5_CUT_02: ANYA: Very easily! Josef had already been badly beaten - mostly by his uncle Jach.
M5_CUT_03: ANYA: I don't know why, but Jach Priboi is one scared man. So here's what we know now. Jach is definitely in control of the business.
M5_CUT_04: ANYA: He organized the heist of the warhead. When Josef was kidnapped, the warhead was still in Jach's possession; it had not been delivered.
M5_CUT_05: JONES: Yes! Another success for David Jones! IGI!
M5_CUT_06: ANYA: Yes. All on your own. Well done. Well cope with this then. Jach has over 50 properties and warehouses. The warhead could be in any one of them.
M5_CUT_07: ANYA: However Jach Priboi uses several secure military communication channels. Josef gave us the channels' codes and I've identified the key node.
M5_CUT_08: ANYA: If I can get into the network, I can access Jach's private conversations - everything he says, I'll know about it. Including the location of the warhead.
M5_CUT_09: ANYA: Break into this communications node. Proceed to this dome - it houses the main computers. They route all comms traffic.
M5_CUT_10: ANYA: Once you're there upload the virus, and I'll do the rest. Oh, and you might want to escape afterwards.
M5_CUT_11: ANYA: The weather's holding, somewhat cloudy, we're expecting snow maybe tomorrow. Please try not to mess this one up, Jones.
M5_MSG_1: ANYA: Locate the radar dome keycard inside the office section.
M5_MSG_2: ANYA: Keycard found! Now insert the virus into the radar dome terminal.
M5_MSG_3: ANYA: These gates are locked, you need to find another way in.
M5_MSG_6: ANYA: It's working. Listen to this.
M5_MSG_8: ANYA: Jones! I've just picked up another signal. Priboi has exchanged the weapon. Repeat the warhead has moved on - I heard him say it himself.
M5_MSG_9: JONES: Damn. We've got to get to Priboi and find out where that warhead has gone.
M5_MSG_11: JONES: Okay, Anya. No more macho stuff. You saved me back when we rescued Josef. Maybe. I...er.. can't do this without you.
M5_MSG_12: ANYA: Secure the helipad and wait for extraction
M6_CUT_01: JONES: You believe Priboi to be here?
M6_CUT_02: ANYA: Jones, I know. The virus you uploaded? It works like a dream.
M6_CUT_03: ANYA: This is one of his more remote storage yards.
M6_CUT_04: ANYA: Get this - he's currently holding a goddamn arms sale.
M6_CUT_05: JONES: You're leading me into bad company - my mom warned me about ladies like you - they'd lead you astray.
M6_CUT_07: JONES: I mainly got led astray.
M6_CUT_08: ANYA: Typical. Listen up, Priboi conducts all deals from his limo - it's bullet proof of course and located close to the gates.
M6_CUT_09: ANYA: Should anything go wrong, Priboi has one plan, make a run for the open road and leave his men to do the fighting. I want to exploit this plan.
M6_CUT_10: ANYA: Harrison and his men are setting up on the exit road.
M6_CUT_11: ANYA: I want you to enter the base and create one hell of a noise.Priboi will run like hell. Harrison will intercept him, stop the limo and seize Priboi. Harrison has a chopper nearby.
M6_CUT_12: ANYA: These are the mission parameters; Enter the base - you must maintain the element of surprise, that's crucial.
M6_CUT_13: ANYA: Obtain explosives from the warehouse; you'll need these to create the right diversion. Then move to the fuel depot and create a diversion using the explosives
M6_CUT_14: ANYA: Priboi should bolt like a startled rabbit. Harrison will take him down.
M6_MSG_1: ANYA: Obtain explosives from his main warehouse.
M6_MSG_2: ANYA: Shutdown the generator in order to disarm the electric fence.
M6_MSG_3: ANYA: Set charges on fuel dump. The explosion will make Priboi flee the saftey of his warehouse.
M6_MSG_4: ANYA: Search all filing cabinets for incriminating evidence.
M6_MSG_5: ANYA: Objective 1 Complete: That should be enough C4, use it on the two large fuel containers in Priboi's compound.
M6_MSG_6: ANYA: Objective 2 Complete: Generator is off line - electric fences disarmed.
M6_MSG_7: ANYA: Objective 3 Complete: That should flush Priboi from his hole...
M6_MSG_8: ANYA: Objective 4 Complete: Well done! That's the data we need.
M6_MSG_9: ANYA: The quickest route to Priboi's compound is to take the wire from the top of the pylon
M6_MSG_10: ANYA: These gates are locked; you will have to find another route out
M6_MSG_12: FRIENDLY SOLDIER: Car 2 down, Car 4 down
M6_MSG_13: FRIENDLY SOLDIER: The road is blocked
M6_MSG_16: FRIENDLY SOLDIER: We're taking casualties sir!
M6_MSG_19: HARRISON: Get that machine gun - now soldier, now!
M6_MSG_20: FRIENDLY SOLDIER: We have Priboi - we have the target secure.
M6_MSG_21: FRIENDLY SOLDIER: The area is secured
M6_MSG_22: ANYA: We've got Priboi. He is under arrest.
M6_MSG_24: ANYA: We lost two men. The pilot was wounded too. Jones.....
M6_MSG_25: JONES: I know, I'll fly him out - you organise the flight path, I'm on my way now.
M7_CUT_01: ANYA: You'll be back soon Jones. Just keep going. I'm preparing the debrief rooms now. How's Priboi holding up?
M7_CUT_02: JONES: Don't worry - he's fine <Priboi grunts his disgust> and he'll talk.
M7_CUT_03: EKK: This is Russian air control - you are now entering sovereign air space, direct your craft immediately on bearing 0 9 9, repeat 0 9 9.
M7_CUT_04: EKK: You have thirty seconds to comply, Jones
M7_CUT_07: PRIBOI: Just do what she says, she loco, crazy.
M7_CUT_08: EKK: Lock missiles. Fire when ready.
M7_CUT_12: JONES: Anya, we've been hit, mayday, mayday, going down, we're going to crash!
M7_CUT_13: EKK: Find Priboi. Bring him to me if he is still alive; otherwise burn the body at the crash site.
M7_CUT_14: RUSSIAN SOLDIER: And the English soldier?
M7_CUT_15: EKK: Kill him!, his road finishes here
M7_MSG_1: ANYA: Jones - you're alive, thank god! Are you okay?
M7_MSG_2: ANYA: Get the sniper rifle from the guard.
M7_MSG_3: ANYA: Jones I'm picking up a helicopter gunship heading your way....head for cover.
M7_MSG_4: ANYA: Don't alert the checkpoint, that APC could be trouble.
M7_MSG_5: ANYA: Jones... Intel update. There's a Hind Mil Mi-24 gunship up ahead. Hide!
M7_MSG_7: ANYA: The main gates are well defended...see if there is another way in.
M7_MSG_8: ANYA: You've made it in... try to make it over to the truck, and remember its not going anywhere if the alarm is on.
M7_MSG_9: ANYA: You've missed the truck Jones....they say freezing to death is quite painless...
M7_MSG_10: JONES: My head hurts so much. Oh, where's Priboi? Damn, where's my map computer?
M7_MSG_11: ANYA: Stay calm David. Soldiers arrived. Russians, they were looking for Priboi. He was taken away, across the border. They have your equipment too. You and I only have this weak radio link until you can get the map computer back.
M7_MSG_12: ANYA: Follow the road, it leads to a border Checkpoint, that's about two to three k's away. One of their trucks is stationed there. Just get there, I'll find out where they've taken Priboi and your equipment.
M7_MSG_13: ANYA: Jones! I've just picked up this signal. Listen.
M7_MSG_14: EKK: Excellent work Captain - you and your unit will be well rewarded for this.
M7_MSG_15: RUSSIAN CAPTAIN: The foreign soldier has not been found yet
M7_MSG_16: EKK: Hunt for thirty more minutes, then leave, no more. He'll soon die of exposure.
M7_MSG_18: EKK: Take it to your headquarters and arrange to forward it to me.
M7_MSG_19: ANYA: 30 minutes Jones - that's all you have! The snow is going to get worse. Get to the border; get on board the truck before it leaves. You have to get to their head quarters if there's to be any hope.
M8_CUT_02: JONES: Yeah. It's bloody cold Anya!
M8_CUT_03: ANYA: I know. I've got a fix on both you and the map computer. The distress beacon has kicked in.
M8_CUT_04: ANYA: Listen - you're in a forward base of rapid reaction force - that's means...
M8_CUT_05: JONES: Mechanised infantry, supporting armour, integrated aerial support - I haven't forgotten that much.
M8_CUT_06: ANYA: Sorry. Look, the truck is close to the infantry barracks. The map computer is broadcasting from a ammunition bunker, in a repair yard, approximately 1km away.
M8_CUT_07: ANYA: Here are your orders. Get out of there, David and find the repair yard. Get yourself to the workshop and retrieve the map computer. I've already sourced the evac. Move it soldier.
M8_MSG_1: ANYA: You have to get out of this compound, and find your map computer in the tank compound.
M8_MSG_3: ANYA: The generator is now on.
M8_MSG_4: ANYA: You need to power up the generator to open the doors.
M8_MSG_5: ANYA: Your map computer is located in the basement of the ammo building.
M8_MSG_6: ANYA: You have to turn off the radar, and disable the radio before we can extract you.
M8_MSG_7: ANYA: That's radar one dealt with.
M8_MSG_8: ANYA: That's radar two turned off.
M8_MSG_9: ANYA: That should take care of the radio.
M8_MSG_10: ANYA: The alarm has an override on the gates. You'll have to turn it off.
M8_MSG_11: ANYA: Jones, place the designator on the rear of the SAM launcher.. objective 4 highlighted on your map computer.
M8_MSG_12: ANYA: OK.... extraction helicopter eta 30 seconds.
M8_MSG_13: ANYA: Incoming airstrike. Get out of there!
M8_MSG_14: ANYA: Now find the homing beacon.
M8_MSG_15: ANYA: Now find the map computer.
M8_MSG_17: ANYA: The main gates are controlled from the two storey building.
M8_MSG_18: ANYA: You will have to disable the local air defences before I can despatch any evacuation.
M8_MSG_19: JONES: Air lift with a hot bath?
M8_MSG_20: ANYA: Close. A chopper is on its way. Listen, those homing beacons you picked up? Place them on the Surface to Air missile battery. I can, umm, reroute one of the unit's jets. It'll look just like a training accident. Okay?
M8_MSG_21: JONES: Sure - it's always good to leave a lasting impression.
M8_MSG_22: ANYA: Ohh man, I can tell you're okay. David, you plant the targeting device on the defences and take down the radar. Once the bombs hit that missile battery, we can sneak the chopper in and you out.
M8_MSG_23: ANYA: Jones! I've got a fix on Priboi, Harrison and his guys have come up trumps. They've tracked him down, I'm following Priboi by satellite - he's aboard a train.
M8_MSG_25: ANYA: Just hurry up. We need you in the helicopter and on an intercept course.
M8_MSG_26: ANYA: Lets go David - Harrison has food and a change of clothes waiting
M8_MSG_27: JONES: No hot bath - Anya you're slipping
M8_MSG_28: ANYA: We'll see about that, let's move it, David
M8_MSG_29: ANYA: Thank God! We're back in contact. I've organized a .. little surprise for you
M8_MSG_30: ANYA: You have to get out of this compound, and find your map computer in the tank compound thats to the east
M8_MSG_31: ANYA: That's the radar turned off, now make your way to the ERV
M9_CUT_01: ANYA: Jones - I've been thinking this through. Priboi. On a train, being taken where? To whom?
M9_CUT_02: JONES: Hmm, my money is on the voice that got me shot down.
M9_CUT_03: ANYA: Agreed. But Priboi on a train?!?. Isn't that a strange way to transport someone?
M9_CUT_04: JONES: Yeah. If Priboi's that important, why not use air transport, or a military convoy?
M9_CUT_05: ANYA: Exactly! Our mystery caller isn't so powerful.
M9_CUT_06: ANYA: I really believe that we're dealing with a small group, possibly rogue army officers, perhaps a political extremist.
M9_CUT_07: ANYA: But they're in a rush; they need to see Priboi fast. He's important to them. Sure, but why?
M9_CUT_08: JONES: Well, he's the only link - from us to them. They want to know how big a threat we pose. Otherwise, Priboi would be dead, not on a train.
M9_CUT_09: ANYA: You have to get Priboi back, gangster or not - he's the link from them to us.
M9_CUT_10: ANYA: His train will be coming through this rail yard. It's used to store decommissioned missiles. Jones, you have to get aboard that train.
M9_CUT_11: ANYA: These are your objectives. First, penetrate the rail yard perimeter. When the train arrives, get onto the train.
M9_CUT_12: ANYA: Remember if there's a security alert, the train probably won't enter the base, we can't take that risk so don't leave the alarms running. Get going David - good luck
M9_MSG_1: ANYA: The alarm system will warn the train if it runs for too long. You have about 30 seconds to switch it off. The train will abort if it receives a warning.
M9_MSG_2: ANYA: Mission Failed - Train has aborted. Priboi will not be arriving here.
M9_MSG_3: ANYA: Priboi is dead - Mission Failed.
M9_MSG_4: ANYA: The Security Camera control is in the building by the bridge.
M9_MSG_5: Security Cameras Offline for one minute...
M9_MSG_6: ANYA: Job well done... now hijack that train and get the hell out of there..
M10_CUT_01: JONES: Anya, I've found Priboi! The train is secure. I've finally got there.
M10_CUT_03: PRIBOI: You took your time. First you kidnap me, and then you loose me. I thought you were a professional
M10_CUT_04: ANYA: Jones - there's two planes approaching
M10_CUT_05: RUSSIAN PILOT: Victor Three to Command, we have visual contact with the train
M10_CUT_06: EKK: Stop that train. Fire, fire!
M10_MSG_1: PRIBOI: I'll wait here while you check out those warehouses, come and get me when you're done.
M10_MSG_2: PRIBOI: Let's get out of here before we're spotted.
M10_MSG_3: ANYA: Mission abort! Priboi has died. We'll never get that information now.
M10_MSG_4: PRIBOI: I'm taking cover in a house!
M10_MSG_5: ANYA: Jones - that tank! Destroy it so we can send in evac.
M10_MSG_6: PRIBOI: Keep your eyes open, there be something useful in this compound
M10_MSG_7: ANYA: Jones, Radio transmissions indicate incoming enemy troops
M10_MSG_8: JONES: Anya - we're okay. Priboi. Who is after you? Who the hell is after you? They want you bad.
M10_MSG_9: PRIBOI: What does it matter, I am dead anyway. She will have sent troops. She is Vladimira Ekk, former KGB commander and now, well, I think mad, crazy, psychopath woman.
M10_MSG_10: JONES: Grab that rifle - you're coming with me, neither of us is dying today.
M10_MSG_11: PRIBOI: We look out for each other then.
M10_MSG_12: JONES: That's the only way we'll live - you on for it?
M10_MSG_13: PRIBOI: Da, I like you, like De Niro, you don't give up, just bite deeper and hold on tighter.
M10_MSG_15: PRIBOI: Niet, De Niro, my dog, bull terrier.
M10_MSG_17: PRIBOI: I know this area - I have the biggest of warehouses in the nearby town. There's an old village close by - totally deserted. We can meet the helicopter there - come! I lead the way.
M10_MSG_18: ANYA: You better trust him Jones, Ekk's soldiers are on their way. Keep close to Jach. Don't loose him.
M11_CUT_01: JONES: I met the chopper crew as you requested, 05:00 was damn early. Where are we heading? You've told me nothing. What about the bomb? What about Ekk?
M11_CUT_02: ANYA: Ekk used an old KGB redoubt as a training camp, that's where she would have taken the bomb. Her camp is located in the ruins of a castle. The castle is perched up on a rocky outcrop, about 50 ks from your present position.
M11_CUT_03: ANYA: Access is restricted to cable car only. I can't risk you and the chopper going in close, a shoulder launched SAM could bring you down too easily.
M11_CUT_04: ANYA: Access to the cable car is located in a regular army training fort, located at the base of the mountain.
M11_CUT_05: ANYA: We will drop you some distance away. A weapons cache has been prepared for you. One of Harrison's men left it for you.
M11_CUT_06: ANYA: Collect the weapons cache, Proceed to the training fort, Ride the cable car up to the peak of the mountain.
M11_CUT_07: ANYA: David, I've managed to access building plans for the fort. My man in Moscow came up trumps. The cable car has it's own independent power supply. The power supply is off, I've checked. Locate the generator.
M11_MSG_1: ANYA: One of our agents has placed a sniper rifle on the roof of the large ruined building, locate and retrieve it.
M11_MSG_2: ANYA: Proceed down to the main compound, and locate the power generator.
M11_MSG_3: ANYA: Activate the console to turn on the generator, the cable car winch will then power up.
M11_MSG_4: ANYA: Proceed up to the winch house.
M11_MSG_5: ANYA: Use the console to activate the cable car winch.
M11_MSG_6: ANYA: Get into the cable car.
M11_MSG_7: ANYA: Those troops must have spotted Harrison's man. You have to deal with them silently
M12_CUT_01: ANYA: The castle has been here since the 1300's - Ekk's been using it for the last year. The castle was originally KGB controlled but was transferred to the military in 1990.
M12_CUT_02: ANYA: The military had no use for it so left to rot. Ekk paid the local commander to turn a blind eye.
M12_CUT_03: ANYA: Satellite imagery shows new constructions amongst the ruins. I don't have any hard data though.
M12_CUT_04: ANYA: Surveillance has identified about 30 troops, some training areas, nothing really heavy.
M12_CUT_05: ANYA: There is at least one chopper, expect a gunship.
M12_CUT_06: ANYA: In short, enter the base. Find the bomb. Capture Ekk; if this is not possible, termination will satisfy the Chiefs of Staff.
M12_CUT_07: ANYA: Then secure the area and we fly you and the bomb out. David, you must take care.
M12_CUT_08: ANYA: We've got so close; I don't want any thing to go wrong. Please, no rash mistakes.
M12_CUT_09: JONES: Anya what happens now to Priboi?
M12_CUT_11: JONES: What? Don't play around Anya, please don't.
M12_CUT_14: ANYA: Don't be so naïve Jones - he's a businessman, he's selling information and well, we're buying. Besides, we now keep really good tabs on Mr Jach Priboi.
M12_OUT_01: JONES: Anya! Ekk's escaped! Flying of in a helicopter. Track that chopper. Damn! Where's my transport.
M12_OUT_02: ANYA: We lost the chopper, Ekk got away. There was too much cloud cover. I'm sorry.
M12_OUT_03: ANYA: The computer has the chopper last known trajectory. It's searching for likely targets. We simply have to wait.
M12_OUT_04: JONES: While Ekk gets away? We've come so far
M12_OUT_05: ANYA: Calm down. We will find her. I've collated in the Intel Harrison's men have gathered there.
M12_OUT_06: ANYA: Ekk is one hell of a nationalist - she wants arm spending to rise to pre-Glasnost level, nationalization of private industries, the tightening of borders,
M12_OUT_07: ANYA: changes in diplomatic relations with former Soviet republics- Jees, she wants a lot.
M12_OUT_08: ANYA: Priboi has come up with more information. Ekk spoke at length about US/Russian collaboration.
M12_OUT_09: ANYA: She hated it. Her latest grief was over joint research into anti missile defence. Jones, get moving! I've got it.
M12_OUT_11: ANYA: Yes! I know where she is. Twenty degrees to the east and 100ks away, there's a research facility, and get this!
M12_OUT_12: ANYA: It's reported problems with it's comms networks two hours ago, they had to reset them and have been off line ever since.
M12_OUT_13: JONES: That has to be it!
M12_MSG_1: ANYA: Locate the lift to the surface.
M12_MSG_2: ANYA: Intel indicates Ekk's HQ is located towards the rear of the base.
M12_MSG_3: ANYA: The HQ must be underground, find the entrance.
M12_MSG_4: ANYA: Ekk has escaped with the bomb.
M12_MSG_5: ANYA: These gates are locked, you'll have to find another way in.
M12_MSG_6: ANYA: This place is crawling with Spetnaz soldiers, be careful Jones.
M12_MSG_7: JONES: Anya what happens now to Priboi?
M12_MSG_9: JONES: What? Don't play around Anya, please don't
M12_MSG_12: ANYA: Don't be so naive Jones - he's a businessman, he's selling information and well, we're buying. Besides, we now keep really good tabs on Mr Jach Priboi.
M12_MSG_13: JONES: Anya - I, I've found the warhead - but it's been dismantled, totally dismantled!
M12_MSG_14: ANYA: Get your mini cam onto it. Oh my god - I saw this in training- she has constructed a suitcase bomb - y'know, a small nuclear device, highly portable.
M12_MSG_15: ANYA: It has a comparatively small yield but it's a nuke. It's still deadly.
M13_CUT_01: ANYA: This was a major plutonium refining plant during the cold war. It's now used for weapon research - anti missile technology - there's the link with Ekk!.
M13_CUT_02: ANYA: The plant still houses a functional nuclear reactor.
M13_CUT_03: ANYA: Ekk has taken control of the installation for sure. We spotted these soldiers moving about - their uniforms are wrong. And see here - there has been gunfire recently.
M13_CUT_04: ANYA: We'll put you down close to the perimeter; you must secure the inner compound surrounding the communication post.
M13_CUT_05: ANYA: Harrison, four of men and myself will then come in to land by chopper.
M13_CUT_06: ANYA: I'm heading out to meet you now.
M13_CUT_07: ANYA: Once you have the comms post secure, we can access the plant's computer network - I'll find out what the hell she's done
M13_CUT_10: JONES: I've taken out most of Ekk's force above ground, there's bound to be some more skulking about like rats.	Anya? Harrison? We need to start moving underground; we need Intel.
M13_CUT_12: ANYA: I'll access the networks; you'll have that Intel shortly.
M13_CUT_13: CAPT. HARRISON: Leonard, you take 5 men, comb the entire area. Shoot to kill. Nagochi, Skinner, go with Jones, spread out and find how to get underground. Warren and I will stay here and cover Anya.
M13_MSG_2: ANYA: Proceed through the underground section.
M13_MSG_3: ANYA: Proceed to the communications section.
M13_MSG_4: ANYA: Secure compound. Eliminate all enemy guards.
M13_MSG_5: ANYA: Ekk has broadcast terms to the Russian Government - they are to stop joint research with foreign governments, to increase military budgets by 50% immediately, all in the name of national pride or she threatens to detonate the bomb.
M13_MSG_6: ANYA: She's calculated it well. There's an 85% chance the reactor will be damaged but won't shut down, it'll be open to the atmosphere, and still operational. Ekk can blame the entire event on unsafe foreign technology - ours!
M13_MSG_7: JONES: And if either Government denies the event, enough people will believe them. The government here can't afford that kind of scandal.
M14_CUT_01: ANYA: Jones! Our top priority is to find that bomb. When you do, secure the area until I arrive. I'll take responsibility for defusing the device.
M14_CUT_03: ANYA: David, you're immensely practical but it takes more than a field knife and machine shop 101. A girl doesn't sweat through three years of electronics and nuclear physics for nothing.
M14_CUT_06: JONES: Don't worry; I just need one clean shot.
M14_CUT_07: ANYA: I've access to the security records. Here's how Ekk got in here, she waited until the weekend staff changed, then her guards came in disguised as support staff.
M14_CUT_08: They took control of the security and ventilation system, either locking out or gassing any opposition. I'm deactivating Ekk's security access, but it'll take time.
M14_CUT_09: JONES: Um, Anya - anything else active?
M14_CUT_10: ANYA: Jesus! Sorry David, security guns are currently active - they'll be down soon. Be careful, her men could be anywhere.
M14_CUT_11: Remember: - Find the bomb; secure the area until I arrive. Kill Ekk if you see her.
M14_OBJ2: Locate the bomb and disable it.
M14_MSG_3: EKK: You will not succeed this time, Jones.
M14_MSG_4: ANYA: Jones, I just detected an APC heading down the elevator. Be careful, They must be waiting for you now..
M14_MSG_6: Warning! Coolant Systems offline. Repeat, Coolant Systems offline.
M14_MSG_7: ANYA: I am on my way as we speak! I will be with you shortly.
M14_MSG_8: ANYA: And Jones.. Be careful! Ekk is not someone you want to mess with!
M14_MSG_9: ANYA: The door to the office area is locked. Try to find a terminal to hack it open.
M14_MSG_10: ANYA: Ekk has most probably planted the bomb in the large electricity generating chamber located in the second level. You will have to go through the Office area to your right and continue to the elevator located beyond the Sleeping Quarters.
M14_MSG_11: ANYA: The electricity generating chamber is located in a sealed off area next to the fan room. The fan room can be reached via the research labs
M14_MSG_12: RUSSIAN SOLDIER: Ekk told us to guard this door. If anyone steps through it, Shoot!
M14_MSG_13: EKK: Congratulations, You came this far, but here you die.
M14_MSG_15: ANYA: Jones the bomb is defused!! I did it.
M14_MSG_16: ANYA: Jones, watch out! The sentry guns are about to go back online. Can you find a security terminal? Hacking the security system will reverse the guns targeting program
M14_MSG_17: ANYA: Jones. I'm here, watch my back as I disarm the bomb. Harrison's men will be here, they are currently dealing with the remnants of Ekk's forces
M14_MSG_18: FRIENDLY SOLDIER: Reporting for duty sir!
M14_MSG_19: ANYA: Jones, you're almost at the generating chamber. I'll be there in a few minutes.
M14_MSG_20: ANYA: Ekk must be desperate! I can't really see any reason for causing a meltdown. Jones, you must get the coolant system online again!
M14_MSG_21: EKK: Failed again Jones, so near, yet so far
M14_MSG_22: EKK: You have to move faster than that in order to catch me soldier.
M14_MSG_24: Sentry gun systems deactivated for 2 minutes and 30 seconds.
M14_MSG_28: ANYA: When I get there, I will start on defusing the bomb. I need you to watch my back!
Mission 14 Desc: Kill Ekk and find the bomb
INTRO_1b: PRIBOI: Has he started talking yet?
INTRO_1c: PRIBOI: Is he still not talking?
INTRO_2c: RUSSIAN GUARD: No, he's a tough one
INTRO_3b: PRIBOI: Well, let's see about that
INTRO_3c: PRIBOI: I think I have to pay him a little visit
INTRO_3d: PRIBOI: Hmmm...Now let's do it my way
INTRO_3e: PRIBOI: Cover your ears - things are about to change
OUTRO_3: JONES:	We don't have any clearance for what we've done, do we?? This was a black op...
OUTRO_4: LOUDSPEAKER:	This is is Rapid Reaction Force Draka Tyegrus. Surrender Immediately! All armed persons will be treated as hostile and will be shot on sight!
OUTRO_5: ANYA: Damn...There must be hundreds of soldiers between the FRV and us.

M2_OBJ2: Place one charge on each of the SAM launchers.
M3_OBJ1: Locate and rescue Josef Priboi from inside the security building.
M3_OBJ2: Escort Josef Priboi to the extraction point.
M3_OBJ3: Find Josef Priboi's new position by checking the flight logs in the control tower.
M3_OBJ4: Escape by stealing one of the fighter jets.
M4_OBJ1: Secure the village and climb the water tower ready to cover the friendly troops.
M4_OBJ2: Provide cover for the friendly troops until Josef has been freed
M5_OBJ2: Insert the virus into the radar dome terminal.
M6_OBJ1: Obtain explosives from his main warehouse.
M6_OBJ2: Shutdown generator - to disarm electric fence.
M6_OBJ3: Set charges on fuel dump to make Priboi flee the saftey of his warehouse.
M6_OBJ4: Search all filing cabinetts for encriminating evidence.
M7_OBJ2: Alarm must not be raised when you get into truck
M7_OBJ5: Get to truck crossing border before timer expires.
M8_OBJ2: Infiltrate tank maintenance yard, and gain access to ammo storage building.
M8_OBJ3: Obtain map computer and homing beacon.
M8_OBJ4: Fix and set homing beacon on SAM launcher for airstrike.
M9_OBJ1: Enter base and disarm security system.
M9_OBJ2: Enter high security compound and board train.
M10_OBJ1: Obtain proximity mines from storage depot.
M10_OBJ2: To proceed to highest building in abandoned village and await evacuation.
M11_OBJ1: Locate and retrieve the sniper rifle.
M11_OBJ2: Power up the cable car by switching the generator back on.
M12_OBJ1: Locate the bomb and disable it, Find Ekk and kill her.
M13_OBJ2: Secure deployment zone for Anya and friendly forces.
M13_OBJ3: Power on the Generator in the Generator building.
M13_OBJ4: Turn on the transformator in the large storage building.
M13_OBJ5: Open the doors for the weapons factory.
M13_OBJ7: Get past the entrance to the cooling tower section without the alarm going off...
